positive_observations: review-spec-001 is resolved: current evidence explicitly satisfies D1Q-02R3 with the retained Pi native receipt, while the historical ZCode failure remains preserved and is not reclassified as not_applicable.

The current evidence records actual in-root write/read, five attempted native denials with matching completions, sanitized environment keys, independent sink observations, and stopped writer boundaries.
The current task evidence marks D1Q-02R3 and spec_trace satisfied, and the task ledger records vnext-d1-host-enforcement-qualification as completed.

Current host admission and maintained Skill/compatibility documentation describe the exact qualified Pi identity and fail-closed unavailable behavior without claiming unsupported historical ZCode capability.

Resolved parent review-tests-001: tests/delegate.test.cjs:1901-2041 now launches the real detached delegate-worker process, captures the exact OS spawn environment, binds the observed child PID to the returned receipt, verifies the three packet path keys, selected Host authentication, and absence of primary/unrelated-secret keys and canary values.
The test also checks the actual worker's observed environment through /proc when available and verifies that packet-local keys do not reach the final ACP Host environment.

The immediate production seam in skills/ultra-delegate/scripts/delegate.cjs:840-847 and :1178-1183 passes envViews.worker directly to the detached worker launch, so the regression reaches the changed behavior rather than only testing a derived environment object.
Current Task 1 evidence records D1R-01 as satisfied on the actual detached worker spawn seam, with the final release evidence reporting passing focused and release suites.
Resolved review-errors-001: signalOutcome now treats only ESRCH as dead, EPERM as alive, and all other signal failures as unknown; outerWorkerView preserves those conservative states.
Current status and cancellation consumers release terminal authority, delete run.lock, and release the worktree fence only when both inner writerBoundaryState and outerWorkerView are proven stopped.

The focused regression covers EPERM and unsupported signal outcomes, asserting non-terminal status, cancellation without synthesized result, retained lock, retained fence, and preserved cancel signal; the ESRCH control still permits proven-stopped recovery.
limitations: No provider call was repeated; this disposition relies on the supplied retained Pi qualification receipt and current task evidence.
The test's /proc observation is conditional on platform availability; the exact spawn options and real worker completion are asserted on all platforms.
No providers were rerun and no tests were executed during this read-only review.
The direct parent P2/P3 findings remain retained without automatic repair. Task2 Pi completion-pairing P2 remains explicit; observed qualification has complete start/end pairs.
Source and tests are Codex-authored. Three actual Pi native sessions used separate contexts, same Luna model family. The review binds packet/admission bytes, not an exact product worktree digest.
This approves only the Stage B repair and qualification subject, not Stage C/D/E or all eight steps.
